meta.name: ad-creative
meta.description: When the user wants to generate, iterate, or scale ad creative — headlines, descriptions, primary text, or full ad variations — for any paid advertising platform. Also use when the user mentions 'ad copy variations,' 'ad creative,' 'generate headlines,' 'RSA headlines,' 'bulk ad copy,' 'ad iterations,' 'creative testing,' 'ad performance optimization,' 'write me some ads,' 'Facebook ad copy,' 'Google ad headlines,' 'LinkedIn ad text,' 'static ads,' 'static ad concepts,' 'ad templates,' 'iMessage ad,' 'chat reveal ad,' 'fake DM ad,' 'ChatGPT ad,' 'Apple Notes ad,' 'AirDrop ad,' 'creative strategy,' 'creative roadmap,' 'creative retro,' 'hook writing,' 'creative review page,' 'present ad creative for approval,' 'motion video ad,' 'faceless video ad,' 'animated explainer ad,' 'motion collage ad,' or 'I need more ad variations.' Use this whenever someone needs to produce ad copy at scale or iterate on existing ads. For campaign strategy and targeting, see ads. For landing page copy, see copywriting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 批量生成广告文案和创意变体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为多个广告平台快速产出大量广告文案和创意。
copy.tagline_en: Generate ad copy and creative variations at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce large volumes of ad copy and creative for multiple platforms.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的产品信息、受众和平台，生成广告文案（标题、描述、主文本）或完整广告变体。它还能分析已有广告的效果数据，迭代出新的变体。
howto.when: 当你提到“广告文案变体”、“生成标题”、“Facebook 广告文案”等关键词，或要求写广告、迭代广告时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一组 Google 搜索广告的标题和描述。
say.note: Claude 会询问产品、受众等信息后生成。

say.text: 分析这份广告效果数据，生成新的变体。
say.note: Claude 会识别优胜模式并产出新文案。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude generates ad copy (headlines, descriptions, primary text) or full ad variations based on your product, audience, and platform. It can also analyze performance data and iterate new variants.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'ad copy variations,' 'generate headlines,' 'Facebook ad copy,' or ask to write or iterate ads.

say_en.text: Write a set of Google Search ad headlines and descriptions.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for product, audience, etc. before generating.

say_en.text: Analyze this ad performance data and generate new variants.
say_en.note: Claude will identify winning patterns and produce new copy.
